products.name: 8MP 4K HD Video Balun Passive UTP Transceiver (Pair)
products.specs: 8MP 4K HD Video Balun Passive UTP Transceiver Single Channel (Pair) for CCTV CVI TVI AHD CVBS
products.description:
cctv , The Nexakey NX-2KV 8MP Video Balun is a passive device that transmits high-definition CCTV video signals — up to 8MP resolution — over CAT5 or CAT6 twisted-pair cable instead of traditional coaxial cable. Built with 2KV surge protection, it's designed to safeguard analog HD camera connections from voltage spikes common in outdoor installations. DigiMark Solution supplies this video balun as a genuine Nexakey product across Bangladesh.

How It Works
"Balun" stands for balanced-to-unbalanced — a small transformer that converts the signal type between coax and twisted-pair cable. The Nexakey NX-2KV lets installers run CCTV video over standard network cable, which is often cheaper and easier to route than coax, especially on longer camera runs or multi-camera installations.
